tileEnv.SH_FIXTURE_DESC: Commodore PET 2001 (1977) at its own untouched cold power-on screen: "*** COMMODORE BASIC *** / 7167 BYTES FREE / READY." in blue-white on black, 40x25 characters drawn double-size (-CRTCdsize) by VICE xpet -model 2001 as a 768x532 SDL window on an 800x600 X root. VICE's model 2001 is the 1977 original and not a badge: RamSize=8, Crtc=0 (the machine predates the 6545 CRTC every later PET used), VideoSize=40, KeyboardType=4 (the chiclet graphics keyboard), palette 2001-blueish.vpl. Keyboard-only exhibit; no pointer device; PET CB2 sound -> ALSA -> AC97 (the 1977 machine shipped with no sound hardware at all, so this is silent in practice).

Emulator-in-captured-Linux BRIDGE tile: a captured Debian 12 kiosk runs VICE (xpet -model 2001) emulating the ORIGINAL 1977 PET; streamhost captures the Linux framebuffer + AC97 audio exactly like every other tile. VICE bundles the Commodore ROMs, so this tile needs no external media. VICE's model 2001 is the real machine and not a badge — RamSize=8, Crtc=0 (it predates the 6545 CRTC every later PET used), VideoSize=40, the chiclet graphics keyboard, the 2001-blueish phosphor palette. The golden is the machine's own untouched power-on screen; the exhibit's interaction is the SPA type-in demo, four lines of PET BASIC that POKE characters straight into screen memory at 32768, which is how the PET drew everything. Keyboard-only exhibit (unshifted keys give upper case, SHIFT gives the graphics set, hence keyboard.letterCase=upper-only). See streamhost/docs/BRIDGE.md and docs/guests/pet2001.md.

reset.fixture: Commodore PET 2001 (1977) cold power-on screen ("*** COMMODORE BASIC *** / 7167 BYTES FREE / READY.") in VICE xpet -model 2001, double-size on an 800x600 X root; golden INTERNAL snapshot restores the untouched cold boot, and nothing is typed before the bake or after the restore. Keyboard proven 2026-08-09 AFTER the bake, against the restored fixture and at the tile's shipped 80/80 pacing: the four-line demo program typed and LISTed correctly (lit phosphor 1841 → 6077), then RUN plotted into screen RAM (→ 10285), then loadvm golden returned the frame to the baked 1841. Keyboard-only exhibit (no mouse); AC97 audio (silent — the 1977 machine had no sound hardware).
